text.title: Activation Tactics Output Contract
text.summary: JSON Schema (draft-07) for the activation tactics playbook step: the activation event and window, the measured drop-off steps with their current conversion and whether a tactic is already live on them, the tactics (checklist with 3-5 event-bound items and one activation item, email sequence of at most four sends with one deep-linked CTA each and send-time suppression, in-app guide on the drop-off screen only, segmented onboarding keyed at signup), a rollout step per tactic whose exit criterion states metric, baseline and minimum lift, and decision branches including the deferral when a step already has a live tactic. Validator at scripts/validate-activation-tactics.py enforces it, including the one-tactic-per-step and checklist-item counts.

required.field: the tracked activation event every tactic moves users toward, snake_case (r-tactic-targets-named-dropoff-step)
the activation window; no email is scheduled after it (r-email-sequence-suppressed-on-activation)

each with `id`, `type`, `target_step` (a `dropoffs[].step`), `step_conversion_baseline` equal to that step's `current_conversion`, and the type's own block: `checklist.items[]` (3-5, one `activation_event: true` that is `required: true`, each with `action` or `tracked_event`), `emails[]` (at most 4, `day` 0 first, `cta_count: 1`, `cta_url` deep link, `expected_time_minutes`, `send_condition: not_activated` after Day 0, `condition_evaluated_at: send_time`), `guide` (`screen` of the target step, one per screen, dismissible, hidden after completion), `segmentation` (`segment_key.captured_at: signup`, segments with distinct `first_action`) (r-checklist-single-activation-item, r-email-one-cta-direct-link, r-email-sequence-suppressed-on-activation, r-in-app-guide-at-dropoff-only, r-segmented-onboarding-keyed-at-signup)

one rollout step per tactic: `id`, `tactic_id`, `action`, `output_location`, `exit_criterion` with `metric` (step_conversion or activation_rate), `baseline` and `minimum_lift` (r-exit-criterion-states-metric-and-threshold)
`when` / `then` pairs with a `kind`; must include `kind: defer_live_tactic` (r-one-tactic-per-step-at-a-time)

forbidden.pattern: a tactic whose `target_step` is not in `dropoffs[]`, or whose `step_conversion_baseline` differs from that step's `current_conversion` — tactic-without-target-step
a checklist with fewer than 3 or more than 5 items, with zero or several `activation_event: true` items, or with an item that has neither `action` nor `tracked_event` — checklist-bloat
an email after Day 0 with `send_condition: always`, or `condition_evaluated_at: enrolment` — email-fires-after-activation
an email with `cta_count` other than 1, or a `cta_url` ending at `/`, `/login`, `/dashboard` or `/home` — cta-lands-on-dashboard
a guide on a screen that is not the target step's screen, or `guides_on_screen` above 1 — tooltip-stack
two tactics with the same `target_step` and no shared `experiment_id`, a tactic on a step with `live_tactic: true`, or no `defer_live_tactic` branch — two-tactics-same-step
an `exit_criterion` without `baseline` and `minimum_lift`, or a rollout step whose exit criterion is "shipped" or "reviewed" — r-exit-criterion-states-metric-and-threshold
more than 4 emails, or an email `day` beyond `window_days` — r-email-sequence-suppressed-on-activation

list.item: Every tactic's `target_step` is a measured `dropoffs[].step` and its `step_conversion_baseline` equals that step's `current_conversion` (r-tactic-targets-named-dropoff-step).
A checklist has 3-5 items, exactly one `activation_event: true` item and it is `required: true`; every item has an `action` path or a `tracked_event` (r-checklist-single-activation-item).
Every email has `cta_count: 1`, a `cta_url` that lands on the action screen, and `expected_time_minutes` (r-email-one-cta-direct-link).
Every email after Day 0 has `send_condition: not_activated` evaluated at `send_time`; at most 4 emails, none scheduled past `window_days` (r-email-sequence-suppressed-on-activation).
Segmented onboarding has `segment_key.captured_at: signup` and every segment a distinct `first_action` toward the same activation event (r-segmented-onboarding-keyed-at-signup).
A guide sits on its target step's `screen`, one per screen, dismissible, hidden after the step is done (r-in-app-guide-at-dropoff-only).
Each tactic has a rollout step whose `exit_criterion` names `metric`, `baseline` and `minimum_lift` (r-exit-criterion-states-metric-and-threshold).
No two tactics share a `target_step` outside one `experiment_id`, no tactic targets a step with `live_tactic: true`, and a `defer_live_tactic` branch exists (r-one-tactic-per-step-at-a-time).

text.reference: Validator implementing this schema and the cross-field checks.
